notes.title: 🔔“Sounds Good” Update
notes.content:
Thanks to the creative work of our audio partners, we’ve added various interaction sounds to all props in the game, making the gameplay more fun.
Besides that, we’ve also replaced some sound effects with better designs and fixed some bugs.

notes.title: 🍰"More Accessible" Update
notes.content:
We did some work to make the game more accessible:
[list]
[*] Improved character control hints in the tutorial.
[*] Optimized Japanese and Korean localization.
[/list]

notes.title: Exhausted Man demo's physics fun satisfied me, an exhausted person
notes.content:
Isn't everything exhausting? Sorry, I didn't mean to tax you with having to think about an answer; I know you're exhausted too. And yet even I, a perpetually exhausted person, was glad to make the effort for the Exhausted Man demo in the Steam Next Fest. It is, like many modern comedy games, about completing tasks by controlling a weird figure with wonky physics—in this case, a man so tired he slithers along like a human slug. I smile every time this horrible slugman crawls up a wall.
